(Japanese: '''マンプゥクタウン''' ''Manpūku Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive town located in [[Paldea]]. It was not given a name in the English [[dub]].

{{OBP|Ryan|HZ106}} is a local street artist here known among the residents. He is known to make paintings with his {{p|Grafaiai}} in the shopping district, offering passersby to paint them something. He lives in a treehouse just outside of the town.

An [[Explorers base]] is located not far from the town.
